## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, could we talk through what’s been happening? If you can, take tonight to rest and think about your options—whether that means taking leave, setting boundaries, looking for another job, or resigning with a plan. You don’t have to handle this alone, and I’m here to listen without judging.

## 2

I understand why you might be skeptical—questioning evidence is healthy. However, many independent observations show that Earth is round: ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different latitudes, time zones fit a globe, and satellites and astronauts have documented Earth from space. These observations come from different countries, organizations, and methods, so explaining them all as one coordinated fake would be far less plausible than accepting the evidence that Earth is spherical.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. That’s why the sky usually looks blue. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering away much of the blue and leaving more reds and oranges to reach us.

雨下了一整夜，城市像被一层薄纱笼罩。路灯映在积水里，晕开一圈圈昏黄的光，偶尔被驶过的汽车碾碎。屋檐不断滴水，发出单调而温柔的声响。窗边的人捧着热茶，听远处雷声渐渐沉下去。街上行人很少，只有撑伞的身影匆匆掠过。雨水洗亮了树叶，也洗去了白日的喧嚣，让夜晚显得安静而深长。
